tools.name: tiktok_list_campaigns
tools.description: List TikTok Ads campaigns for an advertiser account. Use this to discover campaign IDs when the user does not know them. Supports filtering by campaign status.

advertiser_id.description: The TikTok Ads advertiser account ID.

status.description: Filter campaigns by status. Defaults to ACTIVE.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 100). Defaults to 20.

tools.name: tiktok_get_reporting
tools.description: Retrieve performance metrics for a TikTok Ads campaign at campaign, ad group, or ad level. Returns spend, impressions, reach, frequency, CTR, CPM, video engagement metrics, and conversions for the specified date range.

advertiser_id.description: The TikTok Ads advertiser account ID.

campaign_ids.description: One or more campaign IDs to report on.

start_date.description: Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (typically today).

metrics.description: List of metric field names to retrieve.

tools.name: tiktok_get_campaign_details
tools.description: Retrieve campaign-level configuration and settings for one or more TikTok Ads campaigns. Returns objective, budget type, daily/total budget, bid strategy, campaign status, and Smart Creative settings.

advertiser_id.description: The TikTok Ads advertiser account ID.

campaign_ids.description: One or more campaign IDs to retrieve details for.

tools.name: tiktok_get_adgroup_details
tools.description: Retrieve ad group-level configuration for all ad groups within one or more campaigns. Returns targeting settings (audience, demographics, interests, behaviors), bid strategy, daily budget, optimization goal, placement, and scheduling.

advertiser_id.description: The TikTok Ads advertiser account ID.

campaign_ids.description: One or more campaign IDs whose ad groups to retrieve.

adgroup_ids.description: Optional. Specific ad group IDs to retrieve (filters within the provided campaigns).

tools.name: tiktok_get_ad_details
tools.description: Retrieve ad and creative configuration for all ads within one or more campaigns. Returns ad format, video specs (resolution, aspect ratio, duration), call-to-action, destination URL, UTM parameters, Spark Ads status, and ad status.

advertiser_id.description: The TikTok Ads advertiser account ID.

campaign_ids.description: One or more campaign IDs whose ads to retrieve.

adgroup_ids.description: Optional. Filter ads to specific ad groups.

ad_ids.description: Optional. Retrieve specific ad IDs only.
